description.value:
Always on (automated): +1 to Electronic and Mechanical checks.

Bonus Action (once per scene): your next Electronic and Mechanical check before the end of your turn gains a further +1.

Field repair (automated): use the item on a Vehicle, Mecha, construct or device within reach to restore 1d4 Health; press Apply Healing on the Chat Card. It does not heal living creatures.

Reskin freely as training, a perk, an implant, a technique, a gadget or a power.
